About the Portal

This beta version of the Aging Knowledge Portal aggregates, analyzes, and displays human genetic and functional genomic information linked to aging and longevity, while protecting the integrity and confidentiality of the underlying data.

About the project

The Aging Knowledge Portal (AKP) is being developed by a team of scientists and software engineers at the Broad Institute of MIT and Harvard and collaborating researchers across the globe, with support from the National Human Genome Research Institute. We welcome the involvement of interested researchers. If you would like to contribute data or collaborate on analyses, methods, or tool development, please contact us.

Getting started

Are you interested in what human genetics can tell you about your favorite gene, but not sure where to start in the Knowledge Portals? We've outlined a workflow that can help you assess the weight of genetic evidence for involvement of a gene in a biological process. See the workflow in a step-by-step guide or in this brief video.
